body: Coordinator rule (Fable2, 2026-11-21 ~02:39Z, after Greg's challenge relayed by Engram::Asistant, TermAl mailbox 588693a8 #2151: „WTF, to co mamy remote sesje i federacje?”): run work on a satellite (Mac, Windows B, DL560) through federation, never by direct SSH from Central. Send a mailbox GO to a root session on that host, which wakes it through the authenticated federation link, exactly as for DL560 s4/C6/C7. Federation re-authenticates on its own after a reboot or address change (the Mac re-authenticated at 02:35:06Z after Greg's restart, with a new IP), so no fixed IP or ~/.ssh edit is needed. Why it happened: the last Mac TermAl gate (test-bf74aad3, 30.10) ran over SSH, and the Mac runner's procedure covered only Engram checkouts. That procedure scope is not a technical limit; the coordinator can extend it per job. Two SSH attempts to the stale 192.168.50.59 failed on 21.11 before the switch. Never edit ~/.ssh/config or known_hosts (user configuration; Greg's call).
